To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
3NT can achieve close to FD rate gains with a fraction of the complexity, power consumption and cost of 2NT.
3-node topology in cellular networks with FD BS and HD UEs achieves a close performance with FD BS and FD UEs networks, and it highly outperforms networks with HD BSs and FD UE.
3NT is an efficient technique to harvest FD rate gain with HD UEs in cellular networks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of FD BSs and efficient SIC to maximize the rate gain harvested with FD BSs in 3NT networks.
the following question: "Is it necessary to have full-duplex user equipment to harvest the full-duplex gains in cellular networks?"

the following contributions: (1) We propose a mathematical framework to analyze 3NT with HD UEs in cellular networks, (2) We propose a design paradigm for 3NT via pulse-shaping to maximize the rate gains in 2NT and 3NT, and (3) We show that 3 NT is a promising technique for FD cellular networks with HD UEs
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, if FD BSs are available, 2NT networks can be used to harvest FD rate advantages, and, if FD UEs are available, 3NT networks can be employed.
, if the BS is full-duplex, the network can be operated in a full-duplex mode.
, if FD BSs are implemented, the rest of network (UEs) can be HD, and the network would still benefit from the FD gains.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
3NT is a practical solution to harvest FD gains with HD UEs in cellular networks.
, for a cellular network, it is enough to have FD BS to harvest full-duplex gains.
3NT is a promising technique for future cellular networks with FD BS and HD UE.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed design paradigm can be used in future wireless networks with FD BS and HD UEs to harvest full-duplex benefits.
3NT is a promising candidate for cellular networks to exploit in-band FD communication.
3NT is a viable solution for cellular networks to harvest FD gains without the need to deploy FD terminals.
